services.title: Orthodontic Braces & Clear Aligners
services.tamilTitle: பல் சீரமைப்பு மற்றும் கிளியர் அலைனர்ஸ் (Braces & Aligners)
services.desc: Specialized orthodontic treatments led by Dr. Rubiya Sayed (MDS). Correction of crooked, crowded, spaced teeth, and bite misalignments using modern metal braces, ceramic braces, and invisible clear aligners.
services.longDesc: Orthodontics goes beyond aesthetics — properly aligned teeth improve chewing efficiency, speech clarity, and long-term oral health. Dr. Rubiya Sayed creates customized alignment plans tailored for children, teens, and adults using discreet aesthetic ceramic brackets and modern clear aligners.

services.imageAlt: Digital intraoral X-ray unit and operatory chair at Dream Smile Dental Care
services.title: Root Canal Treatment (RCT) & Crowns
services.tamilTitle: ரூட் கெனால் மற்றும் பற்கள் பொருத்துதல் (Root Canal & Crowns)
services.desc: Painless single-sitting and rotary root canal therapies to eliminate severe toothache, save natural infected teeth, and restore strength with precision-milled ceramic, zirconia, or metal crowns.
services.longDesc: Don't let tooth decay lead to extraction. Our digital radiography and rotary endodontic systems allow efficient, gentle, and painless removal of infected nerve pulp, sealing the canal completely and placing durable, lifelike aesthetic crowns.

services.imageAlt: Dr. Rubiya Sayed consultation room and dental certification at Dream Smile Dental Care
services.title: Dental Implants & Tooth Replacement
services.tamilTitle: டென்டல் இம்ப்ளான்ட்ஸ் மற்றும் செயற்கை பற்கள் (Implants & Bridges)
services.desc: Permanent biocompatible titanium dental implants to replace missing teeth with natural chewing power, alongside fixed dental bridges and comfortable partial or complete dentures.
services.longDesc: Missing teeth can cause adjacent teeth to drift and impair facial contours. Dental implants fuse securely with the jawbone, offering a lifelong foundation that looks, feels, and performs exactly like healthy natural teeth.

services.imageAlt: Doctor consultation desk and modern operatory suite at Dream Smile Dental, Guduvanchery
services.title: Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Designing
services.tamilTitle: புன்னகை வடிவமைப்பு மற்றும் பற்கள் வெண்மையாக்குதல் (Cosmetic Smile)
services.desc: Aesthetic smile transformations including professional in-office teeth whitening, composite dental veneers, gap closures (diastema), chipped tooth bonding, and gummy smile corrections.
services.longDesc: A radiant, symmetrical smile enhances self-confidence in personal and professional life. We use modern shade-matching technology and gentle cosmetic procedures to brighten discolored teeth, repair chips, and design your dream smile.

services.imageAlt: Comfortable patient waiting lounge at Dream Smile Dental Care
services.title: Pediatric Dental Care & Preventive Care
services.desc: Gentle, child-friendly dentistry in a welcoming environment. Cavity prevention with fluoride therapy, pit and fissure sealants, milk tooth fillings, space maintainers, and early orthodontic guidance.
services.longDesc: Instilling positive dental habits early protects your child's permanent teeth. Our warm, playful operatory setup and gentle approach ensure kids feel relaxed, eliminating dental anxiety from their very first visit.

services.imageAlt: Reception and waiting lounge corridor at Dream Smile Dental Care, Guduvanchery
services.title: Ultrasonic Scaling & Gum Therapy
services.tamilTitle: பற்கள் சுத்தம் செய்தல் மற்றும் ஈறு சிகிச்சை (Scaling & Polishing)
services.desc: Gentle ultrasonic removal of stubborn plaque, calculus (tartar), and food stains without scratching enamel, followed by polishing and periodontal care to treat bleeding gums and bad breath.
services.longDesc: Routine professional teeth cleaning every 6 months prevents gum recession, periodontitis, and bone loss. Our advanced ultrasonic scalers comfortably clean hard-to-reach pockets, leaving your teeth smooth and your breath revitalized.

pageStory.title: 15+ Years of Dental Excellence & Orthodontic Care in Guduvanchery.
pageStory.sub: Led by Dr. Rubiya Sayed (BDS, MDS in Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics), Dream Smile Dental and Orthodontic Care brings world-class dental treatments, braces, aligners, and pain-free dentistry to families across Guduvanchery and Chengalpattu.
pageStory.sectionHeading: Precision Orthodontics, Patient Comfort & Modern Sterilization
paragraphs: A healthy, beautiful smile has the power to transform self-esteem, improve facial harmony, and support long-term digestive and oral health. At Dream Smile Dental and Orthodontic Care, we combine specialized postgraduate orthodontic training with modern clinical infrastructure to deliver compassionate, gentle dental care.

Under the leadership of Dr. Rubiya Sayed (BDS, MDS), our clinic specializes in correcting complex misalignments, crowded teeth, and bite discrepancies for children, teenagers, and adults using discreet aesthetic brackets and modern clear aligners.

Beyond orthodontics, our clinic provides comprehensive dental treatments under one roof — including single-sitting painless root canals, zirconia crowns, titanium dental implants, aesthetic smile designing, and child-friendly pediatric care. With strict Bio-Warrior UV chamber sterilization and autoclaving protocols, every patient is assured the highest standards of safety, hygiene, and clinical comfort.

patientGuide.title: Important Guidelines for Your Dental Visit

cards.title: First Visit & Consultation
cards.desc: Bring any previous dental records, X-rays, or medical prescriptions. Dr. Rubiya Sayed conducts a comprehensive visual exam and digital X-ray to diagnose underlying concerns before starting treatment.

cards.title: Braces & Aligners Care
cards.desc: Brush gently around brackets after meals with an orthodontic toothbrush. Avoid biting directly into hard, sticky, or chewy foods. Wear clear aligners for 20–22 hours daily as prescribed.

cards.title: Pain-Free Root Canal Care
cards.desc: Our treatments use modern local anesthetics to ensure complete comfort. Avoid chewing hard foods on the treated side until the permanent crown is placed to safeguard the tooth.

faqs.q: Who is the lead doctor at Dream Smile Dental and Orthodontic care?
faqs.a: The clinic is led by Dr. Rubiya Sayed (BDS, MDS), a specialized Orthodontist and Dentofacial Orthopaedist with over 15 years of clinical experience in dental alignment, smile designing, and comprehensive dentistry.

faqs.q: What types of braces and aligners do you provide?
faqs.a: We offer conventional metal braces, aesthetic ceramic (tooth-colored) braces, self-ligating brackets, and clear invisible aligners. Dr. Rubiya Sayed evaluates your bite and recommends the most comfortable and discreet option for your lifestyle.

faqs.q: Is root canal treatment (RCT) painful at Dream Smile Dental?
faqs.a: Not at all. With modern local anesthesia, digital X-rays, and advanced rotary instruments, root canal treatment is completely comfortable and virtually pain-free. Most patients experience immediate relief from the toothache that brought them in.

faqs.q: What are the clinic timings of Dream Smile Dental in Guduvanchery?
faqs.a: We are open Monday through Saturday with two sessions: 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM (Morning) and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Evening). On Sundays, we are open from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM for weekend appointments.

faqs.q: Where is the clinic located in Guduvanchery?
faqs.a: Dream Smile Dental and Orthodontic Care is located on Nellikuppam Road, directly above the SBI Kayarambedu Branch and opposite SP Mahal, Guduvanchery, Tamil Nadu 603202. Click our Google Maps directions button for direct GPS navigation.

faqs.q: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.a: You can call or WhatsApp us directly at +91 80984 80982, or submit the appointment booking form on this website. Our clinic team confirms appointments promptly.
